Three real defects found in the change under review and fixed in place; the rest of the change verified sound (thread-safety of the dual update_job writers, decay math, map-consumer phase-filtering, memo reordering, guard interplay with state_job_guards).

app/orchestration/tasks/segment_synthesi.summary: Review fix 1 (real bug): run()'s as_completed loop called _on_child_segment_tick(status="done") for EVERY resolved child regardless of result.status — correct under the old pop-all-terminals semantics, but under the new done-marker semantics it stamped a permanently-FAILED (or cancelled) child with a phase='done' success marker, lighting its text as successfully finished for the rest of the render and excluding it from pending/queued. Now passes status=result.status (completed -> done marker; failed/cancelled -> pop). Review fix 2: _publish_progress no longer passes eta_seconds=None to update_job when no dispatch calibration exists — an explicit None is not a no-op at the state layer (update_job clears eta_seconds/eta_basis/estimated_end_at AND skips its own observed-progress projection for the call), so every group boundary would have wiped the projection-derived ETA that ticks (map-only writes, no eta key) legitimately maintain, making the countdown flicker out at each boundary for uncalibrated engines. The field is now simply omitted when None.

frontend/src/pages/ChapterEditor/compone.summary: Review fix 3: isReady-via-liveDoneSpanIds alone was insufficient — script-span-text-pending/-book-pending/-queued/-book-queued sit LATER in ScriptView.css at equal specificity, so a span in both a pending/queued set AND liveDoneSpanIds rendered dim despite carrying the ready class. renderSpan now suppresses isPending/isQueued for live-done spans, making the component robust regardless of caller set hygiene. (Note discovered en route: renderSpan defaults to mode='book' even inside the script-line view, so the script view actually applies the -book-* class variants.)

flow_impact: parallel-segment-fanout flow: the done-marker leg now carries the child's real outcome (failed/cancelled children pop, never marked done); the durable-refresh leg no longer clears state-layer projected ETA for uncalibrated engines. Verification: tests/orchestration full package 521 passed; frontend tests/unit/pages/ChapterEditor + tests/unit/pages/Book 303/304 passed (the 1 failure, BookLayout listVoicesWithMetadata, reproduced on clean HEAD — pre-existing, unrelated); ruff + eslint + tsc -b clean.
learned: When a terminal-handling call site hardcodes a status (here as_completed's tick always saying 'done'), any change that makes terminal statuses semantically DIVERGE (done=marker vs failed=pop) silently breaks the hardcoded site — grep every producer of the status value when splitting a formerly-uniform terminal branch. Also: toHaveClass assertions cannot catch equal-specificity CSS override bugs; when a fix's correctness depends on a class being ABSENT, assert the absence explicitly.
